_about: Move hints, one entry each (lane A4 part 5). MoveHints (scripts/ui/move_hints.gd) shows a hint the first time its "when" holds, once, then never again (the seen list lives in user://move_hints_seen.json); Settings > Gameplay > HUD > Move hints turns them all off. "text" names actions in braces, {sprint}, and each is replaced by the player's own binding (key, and pad button when a pad is plugged in). "when" is a list that must all hold; each item tests one number or flag of the state MoveHints builds from the mech: play_s (seconds of play), speed_m_s, running, charging, airborne, skidding, anchor_ready (the wire anchor can bite where it aims), cockpit_view, squad (allied Juggernauts on the map). {"key": k, "min": x} and {"key": k, "max": x} test numbers, {"key": k, "is": true/false} a flag. "order" ranks hints that are due together; "show_s" is how long one stays (default 7).

view.text: Press {camera_view} to look out from the cockpit, and again to come back out.

sprint.text: Hold {sprint} while you move to gallop. It works sideways and backwards too.

jump.text: Hold {jump} to charge a jump and let go to launch. The longer you hold, the harder it pushes.

slide.text: At a gallop, pull {brake} to slide. The deeper you pull, the less the feet grip: steer with the stick while it slides.

flip.text: Hold {crouch} as you let go of the jump, with a direction held: forward is a front flip, back a backflip, sideways a side flip.

wire.text: A wire anchor can bite where you are aiming. {grapple_fire} fires it and lets go; {grapple_reel_in} reels in, {grapple_pay_out} pays out.

air.text: In the air nothing pushes you: the aim stick swings the legs to turn the body, slowly, and the 57 mm's recoil and the wire are your other levers.

squad_orders.text: Your squad is with you. {order_follow} follow me, {order_hold} hold, {order_attack} attack the Legion you face, {order_regroup} regroup.

handler_view.text: Press {handler_view} for the Handler view: the squad from above, what they can see, and a click sends them there.
